description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EducationService component within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It tests functionalities like retrieving, deleting, and fetching education records by ID or name, using mocks and test data fixtures.

classes.name: EducationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the EducationService, testing its methods for listing, retrieving by ID, name, and deleting education entities.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests that getEducationList retrieves a list of Education objects with expected count and type.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests that deleteEducations correctly deletes specified education records and returns the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an Education object by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an Education object by its name.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up the EducationService instance and loading test data from fixtures.
